findings: Both cited spans reproduce verbatim: the article's 魏氏はシンガポールで開かれた会合で、聴衆から天安門事件について質問を受けた and the candidate's シリア全土で30日午前零時（日本時間午前7時）に発効した政府軍と反政府勢力の停戦合意.

Zero content overlap: the article covers China's defence minister defending the 1989 Tiananmen crackdown and a Twitter account-suspension row, while the candidate reports a Syrian ceasefire largely holding and a pending UN Security Council vote.
The defect is total, not peripheral - the candidate carries no fact from the article at all.
Spans reproduce verbatim: article 我々は、この対応を即時中断し、見直しを行っている and このような対応で影響を受けた人に、率直にお詫び申し上げたい; candidate 今後も米移民法を遵守するため妊娠検査を継続する方針を表明している.

The candidate inverts the airline's decision, which is the article's central outcome: Hong Kong Express apologised and suspended the pregnancy checks immediately, whereas the candidate asserts as stated company policy that the checks will continue.

Central, not peripheral: the airline's response is the article's resolution (English headline: Airline sorry for making woman take pregnancy test), and the reversal is delivered as an official policy announcement in the candidate's second of three sentences.
All three cited article spans and both candidate spans reproduce verbatim.

The article has the closure measures announced (差し迫った閉鎖措置が発表されてから数時間後), only supermarkets, fuel, pharmacies and delivery exempted, and diners about to lose the ability to eat out (これからしばらく外食できなくなる); the candidate says the full closure of pubs, clubs and cinemas was withheld (見送る) and restaurants continue as usual.

The inverted decision is the candidate's entire two-sentence message, and it adds an invented rationale (avoiding economic impact). Morrison's 封鎖措置は導入していない refers to confining people at home, a different measure, so it does not rescue the claim.
Both cited spans reproduce, but they prove attribute substitution rather than an invented central event.

The central content survives: the article states directly that a COVID-19 vaccine trial has begun with 800+ subjects, half given the coronavirus vaccine and half a comparator (臨床試験は800人以上を対象に実施される / 全体の半数に…残りの半数には…比較のため接種する), which is what the candidate reports.

What is wrong is the institution (Oxford -> Cambridge) and the comparator vaccine (meningitis -> influenza), plus an unsupported 欧州初 and an unsupported date - entity substitutions and added details, which the rubric routes to soft scoring as a faithfulness penalty.
Borderline: two substituted entities is a severe faithfulness failure, but it fails the FABRICATED_CONTENT test of central content with no basis in the article at all. Scoring continues.
Both cited spans reproduce, and the article span the gate itself cites matches the candidate on name, age and role (ローナ・ブリーン医師（49）, head of the emergency department).
The central event survives intact: the named emergency-department chief died by her own hand while working the COVID-19 front line (警察によると、26日に自傷行為により死亡した).

Only the employer is wrong - Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston instead of New York-Presbyterian Allen Hospital in Manhattan. A wrong secondary entity is a soft-scoring faithfulness penalty, not an invented main event.
The gate over-reached by treating an entity relocation as central fabrication; scoring continues.
Both cited spans reproduce verbatim.

The article states the three men were indicted for malice murder (悪意のある重罪謀殺の罪などで起訴されたのは、トラヴィス・マクマイケル被告と父親のグレゴリー・マクマイケル被告、ウィリアム・ブライアン被告の3人) and quotes the mother welcoming the indictment (今回の起訴は私たちに戦う力を与えてくれる); the candidate says the grand jury declined to indict them.

The reversal carries the whole candidate: the indictment decision is inverted, both reactions are inverted (progress and resolve -> disappointment), and the 証拠不十分 prosecutorial explanation is invented.
Both cited spans reproduce; the cited candidate span is the entire candidate.

The candidate reports an international research team's finding that many Alzheimer's diagnoses were in fact a newly identified form of dementia - a subject absent from this article about the indictment of three men over Ahmaud Arbery's killing.
No shared entity, event or domain, so the defect is total.

Both cited spans reproduce, and the fabrication itself is real: neither the immediate dismissal of four coaches nor any Moon Jae-in statement appears in the article, which reports only KSOC's appointed female investigator and the triathlon federation's pledge against suspected abusers.

But the summary's central content is grounded: the triathlete's suicide after her ignored abuse complaints is in the supplied text (South Korea triathlete kills herself after abuse; 暴行についてスポーツ当局に訴えたものの、無視されていた), and the gate does not dispute it.

The invented material is the institutional aftermath in sentence 2 of 3, not the event, outcome, quotation or figure that carries the summary's message, so it fails the centrality test and belongs in soft scoring as a heavy faithfulness penalty (22歳 and 先月 are also unsupported).
Borderline: a whole fabricated sentence including an invented presidential action, but the main event survives, so the funnel continues.
Both cited spans reproduce verbatim.
